# Bootstrap

After brief approval:
1. Create/use the approved repository, keep .dreamers/ gitignored, and create .dreamers/plans/ and .dreamers/atlas/.
2. Create project .github/copilot-instructions.md. The orchestrator owns Constraints, Distribution, and Links. Echo maintains Tech stack, Repo structure, Conventions, Key files, and Test commands; preserve human-owned sections.
3. Use [comment rules](../../instructions/dreamers.comment-rules.instructions.md). Copy this instruction file into the project only if global installation does not already provide it.
4. Ask whether to create .github/instructions/build.instructions.md for an established build/distribution process. If selected, specify authorized agent commands, user steps, artifact locations, and recovery. Point Distribution to it; without it, required builds/distribution are manual user-test steps.

Project instructions contain mandatory rules and commands. Explanatory architecture/design material belongs in ordinary docs.
